features.name: FastAPI app + lifespan
features.detail: FastAPI(title='CogniBase', version='0.1.0-dev'). On startup: ensure_dirs(), load_settings(), build VendorRegistry + VendorRouter, attempt QueryEngine (None if no embed vendor/index). Mounts 6 routers: vendor, settings, chat, anchor, visualizer, capability. run() launches uvicorn on :8650.

features.name: /health endpoint
features.detail: Returns {status:'ok', version:'0.1.0-dev'}. The only QI-contract endpoint implemented; /version and /info are not yet added.

features.name: /chat (RAG Q&A)
features.detail: ChatRequest{message, vendor?, top_k=6, use_rag=true}. 503 if query_engine is None (no index / no embed vendor) or RuntimeError (no active chat vendor); else returns QueryEngine.answer().

features.name: Vendor routes
features.detail: GET /vendors (sanitized config, no secrets), GET /vendors/active, POST /vendors/{id}/test (ping). Read-only for v1.

features.name: Index serves mockup
features.detail: GET / returns DESIGN/mockup.html (React single-file mockup) as a placeholder until the real retrieval UI (M10) is built.

features.name: Vendor ABC + dataclasses
features.detail: Abstract chat() (required) + chat_stream(), embed() (optional, raises NotImplementedError by default), list_chat_models() (required), ping(). capabilities is a set, e.g. {'chat','stream','vision'}.

features.name: importlib-discovered registry
features.detail: Iterates settings['vendors'], skips inactive, importlib.import_module('Application.vendors.<module>') + getattr(class), instantiates with the entry. list_all_configured() returns a secret-free view (key_set bool, never the key).

features.name: Router with fallback chain
features.detail: prefer (if active) → registry.default(capability) → first active_with(capability) → RuntimeError. embed picker additionally requires 'embed' in the vendor's capabilities.

features.name: Claude adapter
features.detail: anthropic.Anthropic client. Splits system vs user/assistant messages, returns ChatResult with token usage. Default model claude-sonnet-4-6. Active vendor by default in settings.example.json.

features.name: OpenAI / Gemini / Ollama / OpenAI-compatible adapters
features.detail: Concrete adapters present and importable; inactive by default (active:false) pending keys/endpoints. openai_compatible covers LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM, and Ollama's OpenAI mode (incl. embeddings via nomic-embed-text).

features.name: Chroma indexer
features.detail: PersistentClient at Product/ONBASE/RAG_Index. upsert(ids, documents, embeddings, metadatas) in batches of 64; embeddings come from router.pick_embed(). count()/clear() helpers.

features.name: Chroma retriever
features.detail: Embeds the query via pick_embed(), collection.query(n_results=top_k, where=filters). Returns id/text/metadata/score (1 - distance). Empty list if collection is empty.

features.name: Query engine (retrieve→synthesize)
features.detail: Retrieves top_k hits, builds a '[id] text' context block, calls pick_chat() with a senior-OnBase-analyst system prompt that mandates cite-by-id + 'say so if insufficient'. Returns answer + citations + vendor_used + token counts.

features.name: Character-window chunker
features.detail: Sliding window (default 1200 chars, 150 overlap). Noted in-source as a placeholder for a future semantic splitter.

features.name: AbstractSource interface
features.detail: Capability enum (LIST_DOC_TYPES, EXTRACT_BY_TYPE/KW/LC, SCHEMA, CUSTOM_SQL…). annotate() stamps each record with _provenance{source, source_id, retrieved_at, method, confidence}.

features.name: OnBaseSource (fixture fallback)
features.detail: mode=auto|live|fixture. _live() lazily inits the REST client and returns False (→ fixtures) on any failure. list_doc_types()/list_lifecycles()/schema()/extract() read schema.json + *WorkflowDoc*.json; doc-type extract emits synthetic FIXTURE- rows with confidence 0.0.

features.name: FilesystemSource
features.detail: Walks a tree, groups files by extension as 'doc types'; EXTRACT_BY_TYPE (by ext) + EXTRACT_BY_KW (path glob); custom _glob_to_re supports ** any-depth excludes. Records carry filesystem_scan provenance.

features.name: Live OnBase REST / Unity clients
features.detail: OnBaseRestClient methods (list_doc_types/keyword_types, get_document) are written but unexercised (M2). UnityClient methods all raise NotImplementedError (M3).

features.name: Anchor / Workspace models + registries
features.detail: Anchor{kind∈doc_type|keyword|lifecycle|custom_sql|vector|expk, selectors, filters, vectorize}. File-backed registries (one JSON per anchor under Product/Lake/anchors). The JSON file IS the source of truth — no DB.

features.name: Anchor materializer
features.detail: Extract → write raw JSONL to Lake/raw/<source>/<anchor>/<ts>.jsonl → optionally embed records into Chroma collection anchor_<id>. Returns AnchorMaterialization(record_count, raw_path, vector_collection). 3 demo anchors materialized (ap_invoices, isso_students, lc_mat_test).

features.name: Bridge suggester
features.detail: Strips 2–4-letter prefixes (KNOWN_PREFIXES = ADM/HR/FIN/IST/…), matches roots across silos, emits group_bridge + field_bridge suggestions with confidence 0.55–0.95 based on data-type match + Jaccard sample-value overlap.

features.name: Entity resolver
features.detail: Two-phase clustering: deterministic exact-match on keys (non-overridable) then difflib.SequenceMatcher fuzzy ≥0.88 with first-letter blocking. Appends _entity{id, method}. Built + tested but NOT yet wired into the materializer (M20-wire).

features.name: Capability models
features.detail: Capability{kind∈retrieval|report, sql_template with :params, anchors[], required_gate, k_anonymity_floor=5, status∈draft|published|retired, version}. JSON-as-source-of-truth, versioned on every edit.

features.name: SQL validator (safety boundary)
features.detail: sqlglot parse(read='sqlite'): rejects multi-statement, non-SELECT, any Insert/Update/Delete/Drop/Alter/Create/Pragma/Attach/Merge node, sqlite_/pragma_ identifiers, table-valued functions, tables outside declared anchors, and undeclared :placeholders. Reports tables_used/placeholders/has_aggregates/has_joins.

features.name: Capability registry + routes
features.detail: Full CRUD + versions + grants + publish/retire + draft + validate + run + backend health + audit access. publish() and run() both re-validate (defense in depth). RBAC is header-based (X-Admin-User / X-CB-Group) until real RBAC.

features.name: Lake SQL backend
features.detail: Loads only the declared anchors' latest JSONL into an in-memory SQLite (table per anchor, all TEXT in v1), runs the capability SQL with safe parameter binding, row-limits (default 1000), and returns SqlResult with snapshot ids. In-memory DB discarded after each run.

features.name: Capability drafter
features.detail: Heuristic stub that turns intent + an anchors-column index into a candidate Capability JSON. Returns '-- no SQL generated' when it can't; LLM-assisted drafting is planned.

features.name: Audit summary generator
features.detail: On every run (preview or real) writes a .docx + .json sidecar under Product/Lake/capabilities/audit/<id>/, pinning capability version + bound params + backend snapshot + rows so the report reproduces byte-for-byte.

features.name: .expk discovery pipeline
features.detail: Parses OnBase Studio .expk export packages into per-silo discovery JSON, proposes normalizers/augmentations, and builds BU_Catalog.json. 6 .expk fixtures present (AP, ISSO, IST, OAD, PRO, TR).

features.name: Lifecycle visualizer (SVG)
features.detail: GET /visualizer/lifecycle/{file}/{num}.svg renders a workflow lifecycle as pure SVG with population-scaled state nodes (M25-minimal). Full AI-driven canvas (M25) is planned.

features.name: Settings loader with env indirection
features.detail: Reads Settings/settings.json; resolves any 'env:NAME' string from a Settings/.env or the OS env at load time; save_settings() restores env: markers so real keys are never written back. lru_cache'd.

features.name: Path + logging + dir helpers
features.detail: ROOT-relative paths (PRODUCT, ONBASE, RAG_INDEX, DESIGN), ensure_dirs() on startup, setup_logging(level).

features.name: Test suite
features.detail: ≈95 test functions across validator, drafter, audit, routes, anchors, bridges, sources, RAG index/query, vendor router, discovery/visualizer, and server smoke. Runs against FakeChatVendor/FakeEmbedVendor — no API keys required.

features.name: QI_CogniBase NSSM service
features.detail: Service QI_CogniBase (venv python, AppDirectory C:\APPS\CogniBase, requires sqlglot) + QI_CogniBaseTunnel documented in the service registry; not yet installed/running 24/7. Stderr logs show clean manual starts on :8650.
